commercium

commercium, commerciī n.

noun, second declension

trade, commerce (between peoples); dealings, an exchange (of words or letters); dealings, communication

In this lexicon

  • business

    also used · classical · Tac. Agr. 24: per commercia et negōtiātōrēs; Liv. 4.52.6 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 294

  • communication

    also used · classical · Sen. Ep. 38.1: hoc inter nōs epistulārum commercium; Tac. Agr. 2.3 (Lewis & Short): loquendī audiendīque commercium

  • interaction

    also used · classical · Plaut. Aul. 4.4.4: quid tibi mēcum est commercī, senex? (Lewis & Short); Cic. Tusc. 5.66: commercium habēre cum Mūsīs (Lewis & Short)

  • epistulārum commercium habēre cum (+ abl.): correspond

    classical

Examples

  • Meritō exigis, ut hoc inter nōs epistulārum commercium frequentēmus.
